meta.scope: 26 tracks across Over-Nite Sensation (7), One Size Fits All (9), Roxy & Elsewhere (10)
meta.researchSource: Brandon's source hunt, 2026-09-05, across commercial drum libraries, academic work, Zappa score resources and performance material
meta.verificationNote: Commercial listings and prices are Brandon's findings and are NOT independently re-verified here. On-disk columns ARE measured on this Mac.
meta.correction: The 1982 Frank Zappa Guitar Book carries the Steve Vai transcriptions from Shut Up 'n Play Yer Guitar, Joe's Garage and Sheik Yerbouti. None of these 26 tracks appear in it. It is a reference for Zappa's rhythmic notation language and tuplet practice, never a source for these songs.

fields.desc: A complete independent drum-kit transcription of the track

fields.label: PARTIAL DRUM
fields.desc: A drum staff covering part of the track only

fields.label: OFFICIAL STRUCTURAL SCORE
fields.desc: Album book, note-for-note. Gives bar geometry and ensemble attacks, never kit orchestration

fields.label: ACADEMIC SCORE
fields.desc: Thesis or dissertation score, sometimes carrying a real drum staff

fields.label: PERFORMER SOURCE
fields.desc: Written by the drummer who played it

fields.label: MATCHED PERFORMANCE AUDIO
fields.desc: A specific recording or film the tab can be aligned against

fields.label: RED ZONE RHYTHM
fields.desc: Tuplets, simultaneous subdivisions, nested tuplets or rapidly changing odd meters. No automated repair permitted inside these ranges
